parsed.explanation: Tier-1 universal exposure: airport screening compares appearance to passport sex and has repeatedly produced anatomy X-rays, hours-long detention, refusal of entry and passport confiscation (2016, 2022, 2025), reaching every outed visitor. Gender nonconformity itself is a national offence (Art. 412(2), replacing Art. 359) with documented visitor enforcement: 2017 women jailed a year, held in an 'effeminate' cell, heads shaved, hormones discarded, deported; 2013–14 detentions and fines; 2005 raid with five-year sentences; 2020 deportations for clothing. Custody shows beatings and forced examinations amounting to torture; a trans visitor held since 2022 with unresolved status. No discrimination law, no open NGO, censorship and official hostility leave no remedy — state is perpetrator. Absent documented executions or routine sweeps, this sits mid-severe-risk, below 0.15 anchors.
